Name: Exsanguinate
Description: You raise your hand toward a creature you can see within range, having it so in your perspective it stands in your palm. They must pass a Constitution saving throw or suffer from two stacks of Bleed, and then take a number of d6 piercing damage equal to their current Bleed count (up to 8d6). The target creature does not lose any Bleed count from this effect, and if they had more than 8 Bleed count, they instead become Heavily Bleeding.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the maximum amount of damage dealt increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
